ordered_operations: draw exactly seven minus kept-size refill cards
preconditions: The league mulligan examines hands at seven, six, five, and four.
required_assertions: kept level is one of 7, 6, 5, or 4
refill count equals seven minus keep level

plain_english: The league mulligan examines hands at seven, six, five, and four.
The player never goes below four.
After a keep below seven, refill cards restore a seven-card hand.
title: League mulligan keeps at 7, 6, 5, or 4 then refills to seven
